text:
mira: Heads up — after last night's RBAC prune some prod snapshot restores are failing with KMS AccessDenied. Anyone touch the backup service role?
omar: I ran the bulk prune at ~23:40 UTC, could be related. I'll check the TF diff and bindings.
lina: Saw a failed restore alert earlier, job id 472. Any logs?
mira: Restore logs show: "AccessDenied: projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/tenants-prod-key: permission cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt denied for serviceAccount:backup@redwood-prod." Also noticed audit logs gap from 23:45–23:55 UTC (logging agent restart). @audit-bot can you confirm?
backup-bot: restore-job-472 failed: KMS_ACCESS_DENIED key=tenants-prod-key principal=serviceAccount:backup@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com region=us-west1
dan: If audit logs are missing we can't prove what changed. Short-term fix is to re-grant a decrypter role to backup-sa while we triage. Do we have an owner for the key?
omar: I removed a couple of broad bindings in TF to tighten access. It's possible I removed the decrypter binding by mistake. I can re-add a temporary role binding. ETA ~10m.
lina: Also we should confirm snapshot objects weren't uploaded with missing encryption metadata — seen that before where uploader dropped headers and GCS stored unlabelled objects.
mira: Agreed. Omar, please add the binding so we can run a canary restore. Don’t forget to record the change.
omar: Applying now. Command I ran: 
```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding tenants-prod-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:backup@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --location=global --keyring=prod-keys
```
audit-bot: IAM policy change recorded: user=omar@redwood.ai action=add-iam-policy-binding resource=tenants-prod-key
mira: Ran canary restore after the grant — still failing with "No matching grant for request".
dan: Strange. Can someone check key state? If primary key version is DISABLED decryption will fail even with IAM.
lina: Pulled key metadata: primaryVersionState=DISABLED, rotationTime=2026-03-22T03:00:00Z. Looks like a rotation test left v3 disabled.
omar: I did a rotation test earlier this week and meant to enable the new version, forgot to flip. Enabling primary now.
backup-bot: key-version-v3 status change -> ENABLED
mira: Canary restore succeeded after enabling key version. Good.
dan: Notes / action items: 1) Roll back or update the RBAC prune TF to explicitly include cloudkms decrypter for backup-sa (omar). 2) Add CI guard to prevent key primaryV=DISABLED after rotation (lina). 3) Add a watchdog for logging-agent restarts that auto-opens an alert if audit logs gap > 1m (dan). 4) Add a canary that runs a test decrypt as part of rotation jobs.
lina: I'll add a unit/integration test to uploader to ensure encryption metadata header is present and a CI check for uploads.
omar: I'll push the TF change as a hotfix and mark the RBAC prune with a whitelist for KMS users.
mira: I'll file an incident and capture timeline + missing logs window. INC-2026-0043. Please add notes and attach the TF diff and IAM audit record.
dan: Drafting postmortem template now, will include timeline and remediation.
mira: Thanks. Quick follow-up: we should also validate restores for the last 24h that returned AccessDenied and retry those once TF change is live.
lina: Will run a query to list failed restores and tag them for retry.
omar: TF hotfix in PR, linking shortly.
mira: Great. :thumbsup: Closing the triage channel here — updating the incident ticket with these action items.
